description.p: This is a community package of Hestia, maintained independently and unaffiliated with its authors. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
Hestia is a BIM editor for houses: floor plan, section and 3D view of one model, with IFC and DXF. A project is a folder that holds projeto.hestia.json.

Sandbox: display and the GPU for the 3D view, network for the material catalog and the IBM Plex fonts, and the Documents folder for a library stored there. A library in another folder needs flatpak override --user --filesystem=/that/folder com.hestiabim.app. The opening update check stays quiet when it cannot reach GitHub. Installing an update from inside the app does not replace this package; updates come from flatpak update.
